description: This Java class, LoanDisbursementDetailsAssembler, is responsible for assembling loan disbursement details from a JSON command object. It parses JSON data to extract disbursement information such as date, principal, net amount, and reversal status, and produces a list of LoanDisbursementDetails objects.

classes.name: LoanDisbursementDetailsAssembler
classes.description: A class that transforms JSON data into a list of LoanDisbursementDetails objects representing disbursement information.

methods.name: fetchDisbursementData
methods.description: Parses a JSON command object to extract a list of LoanDisbursementDetails, processing each disbursement data entry within the JSON array parameter.
